def reflect_components_as_units(grid, bg):
    """Reflect each connected component as a whole unit"""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # Build mask of all non-bg pixels

    # Find connected components on the MASK
    visited = [[False]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    components = []
    
    def bfs(start_r, start_c):

        visited[start_r][start_c] = True
        
        head = 0

            r, c = queue[head]
            head += 1

                comp = bfs(r, c)
                components.append(comp)
